Riverton, Wyoming / May 2025

Flat roof restoration in Riverton

The old finish had worn away in patches. War Horse carried the new coating across the roof, around the raised base of the rooftop unit, and up the low walls.

Across the roof and up the walls

The light coating covers the center of the roof. Along the right edge, sections of dark roofing and earlier patches are still visible.

In the finished photo, the white coating continues around the raised base of the unit and up the inside of the walls. The curb beneath the unit and the wall edges are visible in both the original and finished photos.
